comment: If any validator has stake accounts from the above stake pool IDs, the rewards from those stake accounts go to the pool reserve (instead of stake account) to avoid epoch delay

4YykTGwg94GgHZEPSsQfbaMaEE9HHAHqSuXT65L6.comment: Validator-specific config keyed by vote account

stakers.comment: These stake accounts are excluded and will NOT get rewards. All other stakers must receive at least the minimum specified in the Reward Collection Account. For example, if validator commission = 7000 BPS (70%), each staker must receive at least 30% of rewards.

g8mdSkn25gekQeGNqttdje8FUQmrwjbRWAeWcMYZ.comment: Requested 99% (invalid, > max 7000 BPS). Lowered to 70% commission to validator, staker gets 30%

CcxbybGo38pQjpyw9N6NwCwemhVUaKKnbHJM3uNn.comment: Validator gets 40%, staker gets 60%. Referral field is set but receives 0%

FFaUCsxGD5iV32er9Cyudti7xiAirZHoXKb4mYNp.comment: Validator gets 60%. From staker’s 40%, 10% is redirected to referral claimant

91gRMhiL8h4i9hC25ZN9a2aq1koA3f5dkNpV37zc.comment: Validator gets 0%. Staker gets 100%. From that 100%, 20% goes to referral claimant

validator_reward_split.comment: Any remaining rewards: 50% to claimant, 50% to validator identity. If not specified, all remaining goes to validator identity.
